section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes

propositions.proposition: FATF对IOs有效性评级低或中的司法管辖区提供关键建议并跟踪其改进进展。
source_quotes: For jurisdictions that FATF rates as having low or moderate effectiveness in IOs, FATF provides key recommended actions and tracks the jurisdiction's progress in meeting the recommendations.

trigger_or_context: FATF对司法管辖区IOs有效性评级为低或中
candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: FATF提供关键建议并跟踪该司法管辖区在满足建议方面的进展。

evidence_spans.quote: For jurisdictions that FATF rates as having low or moderate effectiveness in IOs, FATF provides key recommended actions and tracks the jurisdiction's progress in meeting the recommendations.

propositions.proposition: FATF的直接目标作为起点，评估者使用判断和经验确定司法管辖区AML/CFT框架的有效性评级。
source_quotes: FATF’s IOs are not meant to be a checklist, but rather a starting point to assist assessors in determining the effectiveness of a jurisdiction's AML/CFT framework. FATF expects assessors to use their judgment and experience in determining their ratings.

candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 评估者确定司法管辖区AML/CFT框架的有效性评级

evidence_spans.quote: FATF’s IOs are not meant to be a checklist, but rather a starting point to assist assessors in determining the effectiveness of a jurisdiction's AML/CFT framework. FATF expects assessors to use their judgment and experience in determining their ratings.

propositions.proposition: 司法管辖区只有向其他FATF成员证明其合规，才被视为合规。
source_quotes: Mutual evaluations are strict, meaning each jurisdiction is only deemed compliant when it can prove the same to other FATF members.

trigger_or_context: 司法管辖区能够向其他FATF成员证明其合规
candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 该司法管辖区被视为合规

evidence_spans.quote: Mutual evaluations are strict, meaning each jurisdiction is only deemed compliant when it can prove the same to other FATF members.

propositions.proposition: 现场访问期间，评估团队收集证据以证明司法管辖区的措施已运行并产生正确结果。
source_quotes: During the visit, the assessment team collects evidence demonstrating that the jurisdiction’s measures are operational and deliver the right results.

candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 评估团队收集证据证明司法管辖区的措施已运行并产生正确结果

evidence_spans.quote: During the visit, the assessment team collects evidence demonstrating that the jurisdiction’s measures are operational and deliver the right results.

propositions.proposition: 技术审查阶段，评估团队分析司法管辖区的法律法规。
source_quotes: Technical review: Assessment team analyzes the jurisdiction’s laws and regulations

basis_or_condition: 司法管辖区的法律法规

evidence_spans.quote: Technical review: Assessment team analyzes the jurisdiction’s laws and regulations

propositions.proposition: 范围界定说明中，评估团队确定现场访问的重点领域。
source_quotes: Scoping note: Assessment team identifies areas of focus for the on-site visit

candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 评估团队确定重点领域

evidence_spans.quote: Scoping note: Assessment team identifies areas of focus for the on-site visit

propositions.proposition: 现场访问中，评估团队前往司法管辖区并审查反洗钱法规的有效性。
source_quotes: On-site visit: Assessment team travels to the jurisdiction and reviews the effectiveness of AML regulations

candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 评估团队前往并审查有效性

evidence_spans.quote: On-site visit: Assessment team travels to the jurisdiction and reviews the effectiveness of AML regulations

source_quotes: Draft MER: Finalize mutual evaluation report

evidence_spans.quote: Draft MER: Finalize mutual evaluation report

propositions.proposition: 全体会议讨论报告发现并对评级投票。

propositions.proposition: 最终质量审查阶段，所有司法管辖区在报告发布前进行审查。
source_quotes: Final quality review: All jurisdictions review the report before publishing

source_quotes: Publication and follow-up: Jurisdiction addresses issues and begins strengthening its AML measures

propositions.proposition: FATF使用11项直接目标衡量和评级有效性，每个IO获得低、中、显著或高评级。
source_quotes: FATF measures and rates effectiveness using 11 Immediate Outcomes (IOs), with each IO receiving an effectiveness rating of low, moderate, substantial, or high.

outcomes_or_paths: 每个IO获得有效性评级（低、中、显著、高）

evidence_spans.quote: FATF measures and rates effectiveness using 11 Immediate Outcomes (IOs), with each IO receiving an effectiveness rating of low, moderate, substantial, or high.

gap_evidence.gap_reason: 已有候选只承接了评估者使用IO作为起点并运用判断确定评级，未承接FATF作为主体使用IO衡量和评级有效性这一独立处理链。
